name: Lake Nona Wave Hotel
positioning: Technology-forward hotel in Lake Nona where smart glass, touchless controls and a digital concierge are built into every room
best_for: Travelers who enjoy in-room smart technology
Guests who value refined comforts like Frette linens and nightly turndown

facts.text: Rooms have View Smart Glass windows with predictive sun-tinting.
Rooms have an in-room tablet with a 24/7 digital concierge.
Rooms have voice and app-enabled touchless controls.
Rooms have Lutron ambient lighting and climate scenes.
Rooms use a SALTO contactless digital door key.
Rooms have a TOTO Neorest smart toilet.
Rooms have a 65-inch smart entertainment system.
Beds are made with Frette 400-thread-count linens.
Bathrooms stock Ellis Brooklyn bath amenities.
The hotel offers daily turndown service.
Lake Nona Wave Hotel was named in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards in 2023 and 2026.

highlights.text: Rooms have View Smart Glass windows with predictive sun-tinting.

considerations.text: Rooms run on technology: an in-room tablet, voice and app-enabled touchless controls and a contactless digital door key.
WhataHotel notes the area is a newer development with limited nearby dining options.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
